description: Zone 30 is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Toscana. Its tags are comune-firenze, infomapaccessservice, regolamentazione, velocita, zona. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, SHP, WMS. The portal shows 2026-05-09 as the last metadata change. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
